evidence.citation: “Stop before running any evaluation. First, clarify two things with the user… Then echo the clarified bars and mode back to the user. No blind runners or judges should be spawned until every case has a concrete, judgeable bar and the judgment-versus-conformance ambiguity is resolved.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact requires only pre-run clarification and confirmation needed to establish a concrete evaluation bar and mode. This validates fixture/evaluation requirements before spending a run, so it is necessary execution control rather than materially unnecessary work.
